description.narrative: Project support for the implementation of activities to increase the awareness and participation of youths in the political process in Nepal.
Projektstöd för genomförande av aktiviteter som ska öka ungas medvetande och deltagande i den politiska processen i Nepal.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Summary of results 2013-2016. The results of the project are well in line with the intended outcome; "increasing democratic involvement and access to decision-making processes on local, district and national levels for youths from marginalised groups in the Nepalese society". During the second and third (last) project year Himrights has managed to i.e. -conducted training of trainers in the area of international human rights, -trainings on district level in order for participants to have an understanding of and become more active in decision-making processes at local and district level, -conducted national dialogue with national authorities in order to create a space for discussion between marginalised youth and national stakeholders.
All planned activities have been carried out, including additional ones - hence the activity plan was over-achieved. Himrights has reached 3 495 youths as direct beneficiaries, from over 90 Village Development Commitees, and 420 000 secondary beneficiaries. 76 % of 3 495 are engaged in local level decision-making bodies of Ward Citizen Forums, Integrated planning committees, Citizen awareness centres, Community based organisations and youth groups. Without approval from these bodies the Village District Council cannot for instance approve or allocate budget to any of the planned development projects. Morever, Public hearings and Village level dialogues successfully enabled youths to raise their priority issues and demand for accountability to the local government stakeholders.
The intended outcome, relevant and important, however mainly planned on output levels is considered as achieved, and in some cases over-achieved.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
